## Code of Conduct

First and foremost, don't be an ass.

## Contribution Guidelines

AI contributions are strictly forbidden - if you've found a problem with AI, you must fix it by hand.

If you have a number of commits in one PR, consider if they might work as distinct PRs i.e. two new features bundled with a number of fixes likely belong in three separate PRs, unless there's some dependency between them. This isn't a strict requirement, but does make it easier to process things.

## Questions and Comments

Please feel free to ask in the [Discussions](https://github.com/krgamestudios/Toy/discussions) - I'm always happy to see activity, even just a kind word goes a long way.
